title: DesktopBridge
responsibility: Owns project-scoped desktop bridge request, response, image-reference, and channel models.

inputs.name: RunRequest
inputs.description: designOptions is plan-only, 1–10/default 3. Planning reference selection is carried by FeaturePlanPreparationRequest.

inputs.name: ApprovalDraft
inputs.description: Option is required for an optioned version.

inputs.name: ImageQuery
inputs.description: EntityQuery binds entityId and commit; the optional option names the exact design choice.

inputs.name: FeaturePlanReference
inputs.description: Identifies the exact committed source image, its state and viewport, and optional choice. The host verifies bytes by entity, commit, version, hash and option before generation.

inputs.name: FeaturePlanPageDesign
inputs.description: Every affected page names an exact current or wanted image and exactly three distinct proposed choices with exactly one preferred direction; region coordinates are normalized image fractions, and null means the user requested a whole-page design.

inputs.name: FeaturePlanPreparationRequest
inputs.description: proposal carries shared goal/TLDR, module changes with wanted contracts, and dependency-ordered tasks with moduleGoal. Preparation commits three image options per affected page and returns an unapproved plan; it never starts a worker.

inputs.name: FeaturePlanSelection
inputs.description: Names the selected project, page option and exact current feature-plan digest.

inputs.name: FeaturePlanApproval
inputs.description: Names the selected project, reviewer and exact current feature-plan digest.

outputs.name: channels
outputs.type: Typed desktop channel map; projectWork uses project:work.

outputs.name: projectWork
outputs.description: Reads one project-scoped committed feature-work snapshot when supported by the host.

outputs.name: prepareFeaturePlan
outputs.description: Commits complete, reference-bound, unapproved designs and wanted contracts; dispatch requires a later explicit approval.

outputs.name: selectFeaturePlan
outputs.description: Local desktop feature-plan selection; absent on unsupported hosts.

outputs.name: approveFeaturePlan
outputs.description: Local desktop feature-plan approval and task admission; absent on unsupported hosts.

errors.name: Invalid or stale project context
errors.description: Foreign projects and stale source or plan digests are rejected before returning or mutating project data.

errors.name: Invalid design reference or edit region
errors.description: Rejects unsafe paths, mismatched image bytes, incomplete page coverage and invalid normalized regions before committing a plan.

dependencies.contract: IPC planning DTOs preserve public versions, approvals, anchors and change targets.
